lines.zh: 长腿一迈，能跨过整条沟。
lines.en: One stride clears the whole ditch.

lines.zh: 爪子拖在地上，划出四道沟。
lines.en: My claws drag and carve four furrows.

lines.zh: 我弓着背跑，比站着快。
lines.en: I run hunched over, faster than upright.

lines.zh: 脚踝反着弯，照样跑得稳。
lines.en: My ankles bend backwards, yet I keep pace.

lines.zh: 皮贴在骨上，一走就响。
lines.en: Skin clings to bone; every step rattles.

lines.zh: 活人的气味在前头，我加快。
lines.en: Living scent ahead. I pick up speed.

lines.zh: 我不踩断树枝，我踩断草。
lines.en: I do not snap twigs. I snap grass.

lines.zh: 跑过的地方，露水都发灰。
lines.en: Where I pass, the dew turns gray.

lines.zh: 十指太长，跑时只好半握。
lines.en: My fingers are too long; I run half-clenched.

lines.zh: 尸巫放我出来，就是让我跑。
lines.en: The lich let me out so that I would run.

lines.zh: 我一步跨两级台阶。
lines.en: I take the stairs two steps at a time.

lines.zh: 影子先到墙根，我才到。
lines.en: My shadow reaches the wall before I do.

lines.zh: 我把爪子插进土里磨。
lines.en: I sink my claws into the dirt to whet them.

lines.zh: 站着也能睡，眼不闭。
lines.en: I can sleep standing, eyelids never closing.

lines.zh: 喉咙干得发响，没水可喝。
lines.en: My throat rasps dry. There is no water for me.

lines.zh: 尸巫的指令还在耳边转。
lines.en: The lich's order still turns in my ear.

lines.zh: 我数地上的骨头，数到七。
lines.en: I count bones on the ground. Seven.

lines.zh: 指尖对敲，声音像小刀。
lines.en: I tap my fingertips; they ring like knives.

lines.zh: 这身皮太紧，抬手都费劲。
lines.en: This skin is too tight. Raising an arm hurts.

lines.zh: 有只乌鸦落在我肩上，被我吓飞。
lines.en: A crow lands on my shoulder. I scare it off.

lines.zh: 我记得自己也曾站得笔直。
lines.en: I recall standing straight once.

lines.zh: 风吹进肋骨，我听了很久。
lines.en: Wind whistles through my ribs. I listen a while.

lines.zh: 你脖子上的筋，跳得真明显。
lines.en: The tendon in your neck jumps so plainly.

lines.zh: 我的指甲比你的刀长。
lines.en: My nails are longer than your blade.

lines.zh: 你笑什么？我看不出好笑。
lines.en: Why do you smile? I see nothing funny.

lines.zh: 把手举起来，让我看看指头。
lines.en: Raise your hands. Let me see your fingers.

lines.zh: 你还没被撕过，真幸运。
lines.en: You have never been torn open. Lucky.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的锁骨，那里好下爪。
lines.en: I eye your collarbone. Easy place to start.

lines.zh: 你也怕黑吗？我怕灯。
lines.en: Are you afraid of the dark? I fear lamps.

lines.zh: 别移开视线，我在记你的脸。
lines.en: Do not look away. I am memorizing your face.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，还有汗味。
lines.en: You carry iron and sweat, both.

lines.zh: 尸巫说你归它，我不服。
lines.en: The lich claims you. I disagree.

lines.zh: 皮裂开，里面的骨头露出来。
lines.en: The skin splits and the bones beneath show.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，爪子还在挥。
lines.en: I step back half a pace, claws still swinging.

lines.zh: 不疼，只是被惹到了。
lines.en: It does not hurt. It only annoys me.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我两根手指，我还有八根。
lines.en: Two fingers gone. Eight remain.

lines.zh: 我的血是黑的，溅在地上不好看。
lines.en: My blood is black, and it looks wrong on the ground.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起怎么死的。
lines.en: That blow reminds me how I died.

lines.zh: 缝口开了，我用另一只手压住。
lines.en: A seam opens; I press it shut with my other hand.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，虽然牙也松了。
lines.en: I grit my teeth, though they are loose too.

lines.zh: 尸巫的线被你砍断了。
lines.en: You cut one of the lich's threads.

lines.zh: 我叫了一声，声音不太像人。
lines.en: I make a sound. It does not sound human.

lines.zh: 鲜肉？我十年没吃过热的。
lines.en: Fresh meat? I have not eaten warm in years.

lines.zh: 拿远点，我怕自己忍不住。
lines.en: Keep it away. I might not hold back.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可爪子想要。
lines.en: I am not hungry, but my claws want it.

lines.zh: 你喂我，是想留一只手吗。
lines.en: Feeding me — hoping to keep a hand?

lines.zh: 尸巫不许我接活人的供。
lines.en: The lich forbids gifts from the living.

lines.zh: 肉香让我忘了命令。
lines.en: The smell of meat makes me forget orders.

lines.zh: 放下，退三步，别回头。
lines.en: Set it down, step back three paces, do not look.

lines.zh: 我只会撕，不会好好接。
lines.en: I only tear. I cannot take things gently.

lines.zh: 这块太小吃不饱，你留着。
lines.en: Too small to fill me. Keep it.

lines.zh: 香味顺着爪子爬上来了。
lines.en: The smell crawls up along my claws.

lines.zh: 撞到我，你就站进爪子范围了。
lines.en: Bump me and you are inside claw range.

lines.zh: 我骨头硬，撞的人吃亏。
lines.en: My bones are hard. The one who collides loses.

lines.zh: 别碰我的手肘，那儿最尖。
lines.en: Avoid my elbow. That is the sharpest part.

lines.zh: 你撞得我后退，也算你本事。
lines.en: You pushed me back. Credit where due.

lines.zh: 一碰，我指甲就自己张开了。
lines.en: One touch and my nails open on their own.

lines.zh: 借过，我要去追前面那个。
lines.en: Excuse me. I am chasing the one ahead.

lines.zh: 肩膀相撞，我又闻到血味。
lines.en: Shoulders clash, and I smell blood again.

lines.zh: 站稳，我还没决定要不要你。
lines.en: Stand firm. I have not decided about you.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚趾，那不要紧。
lines.en: You stepped on my toe. It does not matter.

lines.zh: 挤过来做什么，路这么宽。
lines.en: Why crowd me? The road is wide.

lines.zh: 活尸之间，没有这回事。
lines.en: Among walking corpses, there is no such thing.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣还躺在那座坟里。
lines.en: My partner still lies in that grave.

lines.zh: 爪子和爪子碰在一起只是打架。
lines.en: Claw meeting claw only means a fight.

lines.zh: 尸巫能缝出更多，不需要我们。
lines.en: The lich sews more. He does not need us to.

lines.zh: 我不记得被谁抱过。
lines.en: I do not remember being held.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，先比谁的爪子长。
lines.en: Kin meet and compare claw length first.

lines.zh: 血都凉了，还谈什么繁衍。
lines.en: My blood is cold. Breeding is not a topic.

lines.zh: 别问了，这问题让我空得慌。
lines.en: Do not ask. The question leaves me hollow.

lines.zh: 想要后代，去找尸巫的针。
lines.en: Want offspring? Go find the lich's needle.

lines.zh: 两具活尸并排走，也只是并排。
lines.en: Two ghouls walking side by side. Only that.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的剑，握不住。
lines.en: I pick up your sword and cannot hold it.

lines.zh: 指头太长，捡东西很费劲。
lines.en: My fingers are too long for picking things up.

lines.zh: 这块布，我拿来擦爪子。
lines.en: This cloth — I will wipe my claws on it.

lines.zh: 落在泥里的，没人会来认领。
lines.en: What falls in the mud is never claimed.

lines.zh: 我把它夹在两根肋骨中间。
lines.en: I wedge it between two of my ribs.

lines.zh: 骨头，这个我要，别碰。
lines.en: A bone. This one is mine. Do not touch.

lines.zh: 我低头去叼，脖子响了一声。
lines.en: I stoop to take it; my neck pops.

lines.zh: 这是尸巫的东西，我认得。
lines.en: This belongs to the lich. I know the mark.

lines.zh: 捡了又掉，我的指尖太滑。
lines.en: I pick it up, drop it. My fingertips are slick.

lines.zh: 你松手，我就当没看见你。
lines.en: Let go, and I will pretend I never saw you.

lines.zh: 那个活物，归我了。
lines.en: That living thing. Mine.

lines.zh: 爪子开始发麻，这是要动手了。
lines.en: My claws go numb. That means it is time.

lines.zh: 它背上的肉，我看得很清楚。
lines.en: The meat on its back is very clear to me.

lines.zh: 不是悚怖的，一律算猎物。
lines.en: Not of the dread — prey, without exception.

lines.zh: 我贴地过去，爪子先着地。
lines.en: I creep low, claws touching down first.

lines.zh: 尸巫指了方向，我照做。
lines.en: The lich pointed. I obey the direction.

lines.zh: 它回头了，可惜太晚。
lines.en: It turned around. Too late.

lines.zh: 我要从背后开一个口子。
lines.en: I will open a seam from behind.

lines.zh: 那匹马也算活物，很好。
lines.en: That horse counts as living. Good.

lines.zh: 先撕腿筋，它就跑不动了。
lines.en: Tendons first, then it cannot run.

lines.zh: 三个活物，我挑最近那个。
lines.en: Three living things. I take the nearest.

lines.zh: 我的心不跳，可我知道咬哪。
lines.en: My heart is still, but I know where to bite.

lines.zh: 它握紧了武器，握紧也没用。
lines.en: It grips its weapon. Gripping will not help.

lines.zh: 动手之前，我先伸直十指。
lines.en: Before I strike, I straighten all ten fingers.

lines.zh: 有活物在墙那边喘气。
lines.en: Something living is breathing past that wall.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张开手，让它看清爪子。
lines.en: I spread my hands slowly so it sees the claws.

lines.zh: 它退到墙角，正合我意。
lines.en: It backs into the corner. Exactly what I want.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，脚不出声。
lines.en: I circle it without a sound from my feet.

lines.zh: 它举盾，盾边有缝。
lines.en: It raises a shield. The rim has a gap.

lines.zh: 等它眨眼，我就上前一步。
lines.en: When it blinks, I take one step closer.

lines.zh: 它喊人，喊声会引来更多猎物。
lines.en: It shouts for help; shouts draw more prey.

lines.zh: 我的影子在它脚边散开。
lines.en: My shadow spreads around its feet.

lines.zh: 它想绕后，我早转过来了。
lines.en: It tries to flank me. I already turned.

lines.zh: 再近一步，爪子就够到喉咙。
lines.en: One step closer and my claws reach its throat.

lines.zh: 它呼吸乱了，我听得见。
lines.en: Its breathing has gone ragged. I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我不急，活尸最不缺时间。
lines.en: I am in no hurry. The dead have time.

lines.zh: 它把火把举高，我不喜欢火。
lines.en: It lifts a torch high. I dislike fire.

lines.zh: 哪只手先动，我先撕哪只。
lines.en: Whichever hand moves first, I tear that one.

lines.zh: 尸巫要活的，我留一口气给它。
lines.en: The lich wants it alive. I will leave it some breath.

lines.zh: 我把指爪一根根掰响。
lines.en: I crack my claws one by one.

lines.zh: 它把背贴上了墙，墙是凉的。
lines.en: It presses its back to the wall; the wall is cold.

lines.zh: 我低头看它的脚，先绊那里的。
lines.en: I look down at its feet; those I trip first.

lines.zh: 它抬手挡脸，肋下就空了。
lines.en: It guards its face, leaving its ribs open.

lines.zh: 一爪下去，三道口子。
lines.en: One swipe, three long lines.

lines.zh: 我交叉挥爪，它挡不住两边。
lines.en: I cross my claws. It cannot block both sides.

lines.zh: 指甲卡在骨头里，我拔出来。
lines.en: A nail lodges in bone. I pull it free.

lines.zh: 撕开衣甲，比撕皮容易。
lines.en: Armor tears easier than skin does.

lines.zh: 我抓住它的手腕，往反方向扭。
lines.en: I seize its wrist and twist it backwards.

lines.zh: 这一爪落在脸上，它看不见了。
lines.en: This swipe lands on the face; it goes blind.

lines.zh: 我用膝盖顶它，爪子随后就到。
lines.en: I drive a knee in, claws following after.

lines.zh: 它砍中我的小臂，我照样挥。
lines.en: It cuts my forearm; I swing anyway.

lines.zh: 两爪合拢，像剪刀。
lines.en: Both claws close like a pair of shears.

lines.zh: 它倒下时，我按住它肩膀。
lines.en: As it falls, I pin its shoulder down.

lines.zh: 我的指甲断了一根，不值钱。
lines.en: One nail broke. Worthless.

lines.zh: 血顺着手腕流到指尖。
lines.en: Blood runs down my wrist to my fingertips.

lines.zh: 它想推开我，我比它想的沉。
lines.en: It tries to shove me off. I am heavier than that.

lines.zh: 尸巫教的顺序：眼、喉、腿。
lines.en: The lich's order: eyes, throat, legs.

lines.zh: 我的爪子从它肩胛划到腰。
lines.en: My claws rake from its shoulder blade to its waist.

lines.zh: 它用剑柄砸我，我退了半步。
lines.en: It hits me with a pommel; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 土裂开，我先伸出十根手指。
lines.en: The soil splits and I push ten fingers out first.

lines.zh: 尸巫念完那个词，我就站起来了。
lines.en: The lich finished the word, and I stood.

lines.zh: 这具身体很轻，跑起来正好。
lines.en: This body is light. Good for running.

lines.zh: 睁开眼，先看见自己的爪子。
lines.en: I open my eyes and see my own claws first.

lines.zh: 悚陵的风把我身上的土吹掉。
lines.en: Wind from the dread tomb blows the soil off me.

lines.zh: 我记得路，却不记得名字。
lines.en: I remember the road, not my name.

lines.zh: 手上沾的血，不是我的。
lines.en: The blood on my hands is not mine.

lines.zh: 尸巫点头，我就出发了。
lines.en: The lich nodded. I set out.

lines.zh: 附近有炊烟，那就先吃那家。
lines.en: Smoke rises nearby. I will start at that house.

lines.zh: 我抖掉指甲缝里的泥。
lines.en: I shake the mud from under my nails.

lines.zh: 活物的声音，一下子全涌进来。
lines.en: The sounds of the living rush in at once.

lines.zh: 我从墓顶爬下，摔断了一节手指。
lines.en: I climb down the tomb and snap one finger.

lines.zh: 这一片，现在归悚怖所有。
lines.en: This stretch of ground now belongs to the dread.

lines.zh: 尸巫说要快，我没打算慢。
lines.en: The lich said be swift. I do not plan to dawdle.

lines.zh: 火一沾皮，我就倒退着走。
lines.en: Fire touches my skin; I walk backwards away.

lines.zh: 从高处摔下，膝盖反折了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my knee folds wrong.

lines.zh: 水里我抓不住东西，一直沉。
lines.en: In water my claws grip nothing; I keep sinking.

lines.zh: 炸得我耳朵嗡嗡的，本来也听不清。
lines.en: The blast leaves my ears ringing, not that they worked.

lines.zh: 箭穿过去了，留下个干净的洞。
lines.en: The arrow passes through and leaves a clean hole.

lines.zh: 咒文贴上皮，像被烫了一下。
lines.en: The spell settles on my skin like a burn.

lines.zh: 饿得爪子发颤，这不该发生。
lines.en: Hunger makes my claws tremble. That should not happen.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的影子断成两半。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my shadow splits in two.

lines.zh: 虚空没有地面，我抓不住任何东西。
lines.en: The void has no floor. My claws find nothing.
